situation: Choosing a serving engine for write-capable GLM agents (GLM-4.7-Flash / GLM-4.6V).
decision: Prefer vLLM or SGLang over GGUF/llama.cpp for GLM agents that can write (filesystem, shell, DB); treat community INT4/GGUF conversions as experimental only.
reasoning_physics: llama.cpp reports document GLM-4.7-Flash problems across CUDA, Vulkan, flash-attention, and quantized KV caches. A flaky engine under a write-capable agent is a failure-amplification boundary; vLLM/SGLang support native GLM tool parsing deterministically. Bad default = unsafe writes.
